title: Original Prehistoric Lowpoly Environment Pack: Ten Distinct Categories
scientificScope: Evidence-informed stylized concepts; not species/site reconstructions
units: meters; targetMeters = width,height,depth; artistic asset dimensions, not fossil measurements

assets.period: A time-neutral sedimentary-landform concept. Red-brown colors may evoke the Early Jurassic Kayenta setting without reconstructing its topography at that time.
assets.form: A broad, thick, asymmetric rock face with 3–5 continuous beds of unequal thickness; harder layers project beyond softer layers, with a lateral joint and debris at the base.
assets.distinct: Solid rock mass and continuous bedding define a terrain backdrop or occluding form, rather than a random cluster of stones.
assets.science: Bedding records depositional differences. An exposed cliff can be much younger than the sediments that formed its rock.
avoid: Presenting today's Zion canyon as a dinosaur-age landscape
Coloring every bed a different rainbow hue
Reusing the arch mesh with its opening filled
assets.art: The exact bed count, eroded shape, and red-brown colors are stylized choices, not a measured stratigraphic reconstruction.

zhCN.period: 跨时代沉积岩地貌概念；红褐配色可呼应早侏罗纪Kayenta，但不复刻其当时地形
zhCN.form: 宽厚不对称岩壁；3–5条连续但厚薄不同的层理；硬层略突出、软层后退；一处横向节理和碎屑基脚
zhCN.distinct: 实体岩壁与连续层理；主要用途是地形背景/遮挡，不是随机石头簇
zhCN.science: 层理代表沉积差异；今天露出的岩崖可比沉积晚得多
avoid: 把今日Zion峡谷当成恐龙时代景观
每个岩层涂彩虹色
与天然石拱共用网格只去掉中间一块
zhCN.art: 精确层数、侵蚀外形及红褐颜色为风格化，不宣称地层测量复原

assets.period: A time-neutral erosional-landform concept, without a fossil locality or claimed Paleozoic/Mesozoic formation date.
assets.form: A continuous, off-center through-opening; supports of unequal thickness; a substantial arch crown; and readable rock volume from front and rear.
assets.distinct: The through-opening and supported arch silhouette differ fundamentally from the solid stepped mass of the layered outcrop.
assets.science: Joints, variations in layer resistance, and erosion can form arches. Sediment deposition age is not the age of the resulting arch.
avoid: Copying a famous modern arch into a Jurassic scene and calling it an authentic setting
Representing the opening only with a texture
A paper-thin arch crown
Confusing the landform with an artificial masonry arch or a bridge over a waterfall
assets.art: The structural proportions and erosion pattern are original landform design, not evidence for a particular ancient environment.

zhCN.period: 跨时代侵蚀地貌概念；不指明化石地点或古生代/中生代形成时间
zhCN.form: 一条连续、可看穿的偏心拱孔；左右支脚不同粗细；拱顶留足实体厚度；前后均有地质体量
zhCN.distinct: 贯穿负空间、承重拱桥轮廓，和层理岩崖的实心台阶体完全不同
zhCN.science: 节理、软硬层和侵蚀可形成石拱；岩石沉积年龄不等于拱门形成年龄
avoid: 把现代著名石拱复制进侏罗纪并声称实景
拱孔只靠贴图
薄纸般拱顶
瀑布桥或人工砌石拱混淆
zhCN.art: 构造比例与侵蚀形态为原创地貌设计，不是具体古环境证据

assets.period: This design is intended for stylized Jurassic–Cretaceous woodland. The lineage has a broader history, but this particular form is not universally applicable.
assets.form: A straight main trunk with whorled or near-whorled lateral branches at varied heights; separated foliage tiers rather than a continuous Christmas-tree cone; some broken branches and an asymmetric crown.
assets.distinct: A tall main axis with tiered lateral branches differs from the lycopsid's columnar trunk and upper dichotomous branching.
assets.science: Conifers coexisted with dinosaurs. Araucaria-like tree architecture is a morphological inspiration, not a claim to reproduce a modern Araucaria species in deep time.
avoid: Claiming that a modern species remained unchanged for 200 million years
Stacking identical cones
Flowers or broadleaf-tree fruits
Default placement in a Carboniferous coal swamp
assets.art: Height, crown form, aggregated foliage, and green colors are design choices, not a species identification from Kayenta or Iren Dabasu.

zhCN.period: 本款供侏罗纪—白垩纪风格化树林；类群年代比此广，不等于本款外形处处适用
zhCN.form: 通直主干、不同高度轮生/近轮生侧枝；分层展开的枝叶体；轮廓不是连续圣诞树圆锥；局部断枝与非对称冠幅
zhCN.distinct: 高乔木主轴＋横向分层侧枝，和鳞木的高柱状主干/顶部二歧分枝不同
zhCN.science: 针叶植物与恐龙共存；使用南洋杉式树形启发，不命名为现代南洋杉物种的原样复刻
avoid: 声称某现代种两亿年未改变
同一块圆锥重复堆叠
花朵/阔叶果实
强制用于石炭纪煤沼
zhCN.art: 高度、冠型、叶片成团与绿色为视觉设计；不是Kayenta或Iren Dabasu特定种鉴定

assets.period: A Mesozoic-inspired plant concept. A named cycad or bennettitalean reconstruction requires separate checks of taxonomy and reproductive structures.
assets.form: A short, stout stem with leaf-base texture; a radiating crown of stiff pinnate leaves; narrow tapering leaflets along each axis; optionally one restrained cycad-like cone.
assets.distinct: A low stout stem and stiff elevated crown need a different structure from an enlarged ground-fern clump.
assets.science: Cycads can superficially resemble palms but are not palms. Cycads and bennettitaleans cannot be treated as the same group solely because of pinnate leaves.
avoid: Coconuts or a tall bare palm trunk
Petal-like flowers
Combining unrelated reproductive structures on one plant
Presenting cycads as the staple food of all dinosaurs
assets.art: Leaf count, angles, color, and stem proportions are stylized. An optional cone is not an identification claim.

zhCN.period: 供中生代风格化植被；若做具体苏铁或本内苏铁须另外核对分类/繁殖结构
zhCN.form: 矮粗具叶基纹理的干；冠部放射状硬挺羽状叶；狭长小叶沿中轴排列且尖端收细；允许一枚低调的苏铁式球果
zhCN.distinct: 矮粗干＋上方刚性放射冠，不能拿蕨叶丛放大替代
zhCN.science: 苏铁形态与棕榈表面相似但不是棕榈；苏铁与本内苏铁也不能仅凭羽叶混为一类
avoid: 椰子或棕榈长裸干
花瓣状花朵
给一株随意加不同类群繁殖器官
把苏铁当所有恐龙主食
zhCN.art: 叶片数量、叶角、颜色及树干短粗比例为风格化；球果不用作鉴定证据

assets.period: A Mesozoic fern-form concept by default. In a Carboniferous scene it could only serve as a broad fern illustration, not the same named modern species.
assets.form: 7–11 curved fronds emerging close to the ground; alternating or slightly asymmetric pinnae; one unfurling young frond; gaps within the clump and drooping outer edges.
assets.distinct: Low growth, flexible curved fronds, and finely divided pinnae distinguish it from the stiff cycad crown and jointed horsetail stems.
assets.science: Ferns reproduce through spores. A modern garden fern species should not automatically be identified as its Mesozoic counterpart.
avoid: Adding strings of seeds or flowers beneath fronds
Treating ferns as equivalent to seed ferns
Making every frond identical in length and angle
Reducing an entire frond to a flat triangular plate
assets.art: Omitted subdivisions and colors are stylization. Unfurling illustrates growth; not every frond should be coiled.

zhCN.period: 本款默认为中生代蕨类形态概念；石炭纪场景只能作宽泛蕨类示意，不能冒称同一现代种
zhCN.form: 7–11片从近地生长点展开的弧形叶轴；羽片交错/略不对称；一片新生卷叶；叶丛留孔隙与下垂外缘
zhCN.distinct: 近地、柔软弯曲、细分羽片；和苏铁刚性放射冠、木贼节茎有明显差别
zhCN.science: 蕨用孢子繁殖；现代花园中的具体蕨种不能直接标作中生代原种
avoid: 给叶背加成串种子/花
与种子蕨等同
所有叶完全同长同角
整片叶只有平面三角板
zhCN.art: 羽片省略和颜色为风格化；卷叶是生长形态示意，不是每片叶都螺旋

assets.period: A small horsetail-form concept suitable for a Mesozoic setting. Enlarging this design does not make it a Carboniferous Calamites reconstruction.
assets.form: 5–9 segmented stems of unequal heights; visible nodes and sheaths; tiers of fine whorled branches; a few unbranched stems; optional terminal strobili on selected stems.
assets.distinct: Multiple jointed axes and brush-like whorled branches make it different from bamboo or an unstructured grass tuft.
assets.science: Ancient horsetail relatives included diverse body sizes. Tree-sized Calamites requires its own structural reconstruction.
avoid: Bamboo or broad leaves
Scaling a modern one-meter horsetail directly into a twenty-meter Calamites
Depicting a flowering reed
Covering dry dunes far from water with wet-margin horsetails
assets.art: Stem count, branch density, and dimensions are illustrative. Suggested waterside placement is ecological guidance, not evidence from a specific stratum.

zhCN.period: 本款为中生代适用的小型木贼形概念；不得放大后冒称石炭纪Calamites芦木
zhCN.form: 5–9根高低不一节茎；节点环/鞘清晰；分层细侧枝成轮；少量无枝茎；可设少数顶生孢子囊穗
zhCN.distinct: 多根节茎＋轮生侧枝的刷状线条，不是竹子或草丛
zhCN.science: 木贼类在古环境中有多种体型；芦木是另需结构复原的树状近亲
avoid: 竹叶或阔叶
把现代1米木贼整体缩放成20米芦木
画成开花芦苇
离水很远的沙丘布满湿生木贼
zhCN.art: 株数、枝密度、尺寸为群落示意；水边摆放是生态建议，不是特定层位证据

assets.period: A Mesozoic seed-plant/conifer deadwood concept. Do not use this as a reconstruction of lycopsid uprooting.
assets.form: An inclined long trunk with a splintered or forked break; an asymmetric root plate retaining soil; 2–3 broken branches; patches of missing bark and slightly darker contact areas.
assets.distinct: Horizontal collapse, a root plate, and natural breakage require more than turning a living tree sideways and deleting its leaves.
assets.science: Fossil wood can preserve decay. Root architecture and modes of collapse differ among plant groups.
avoid: A clean saw-cut end
Modern wood rings and a large root plate on a fern or lycopsid stem
Adding eyes to create a monster
Adding an unverified named fungus
assets.art: Fall angle, decay, roots, and surface colors are ecological-prop design, not a reconstruction of a particular death event.

zhCN.period: 本款为中生代种子植物/针叶树倒木概念；禁当作鳞木倒伏复原
zhCN.form: 倾斜长干、分叉折断端、附着土块的非对称根盘、2–3处折枝；树皮剥落露木质；接地部略压暗
zhCN.distinct: 横向倒伏、根盘及断裂叙事；不能拿乔木横放后删叶作为完成品
zhCN.science: 木材与腐朽痕迹可见于化石；根系与倒伏方式随植物类群不同
avoid: 电锯般平整切口
给蕨干/鳞木画现代木材年轮与大根盘
贴上眼睛变怪物
加未核实真菌物种
zhCN.art: 倒伏角、腐朽程度、根形和表面色为生态道具设计，不还原一个死亡事件

assets.period: A teaching model inspired by Late Cretaceous oviraptorid nest arrangements, without assignment to Gigantoraptor or any museum exhibit animal.
assets.form: A low ground depression with a sediment rim; elongated eggs in a few approximate pairs or arcs around a central opening; intact eggs in a calm presentation.
assets.distinct: A shallow nest with recognizable eggs is a reproductive trace prop, structurally and functionally different from vegetation or rocks.
assets.science: Some oviraptorid fossils directly associate adults with nests. Nearby bones alone do not identify which animal laid a clutch.
avoid: Claiming that all dinosaurs nested this way
Labeling it a Gigantoraptor nest
A woven basket-like tree nest
Injured or frightened hatchlings
Treating artistic egg colors as fossil color evidence
assets.art: Egg count, colors, proportions, and simplified arrangement are educational design choices, not a measured specimen reconstruction.

zhCN.period: 晚白垩世窃蛋龙类卵窝形式启发的教学示意；不指定为巨盗龙或馆内任何动物
zhCN.form: 低矮地面凹窝、泥沙边缘；较长卵成少量近似配对/弧形排列，保留中央空隙；使用完整、平静的卵
zhCN.distinct: 地表低窝＋可识别卵群，形态和功能均非植被/石块
zhCN.science: 部分窃蛋龙类确有成体与卵窝关联；卵窝归属不能仅凭附近出现哪种骨骼猜测
avoid: 宣称所有恐龙都这样筑巢
写巨盗龙巢
现代树枝编织鸟巢篮
加受伤/惊吓孵化动物
以艺术色指认卵色化石证据
zhCN.art: 卵数、颜色、比例及排列简化为教学设计；不是特定标本测绘复原

assets.period: A Mesozoic dinosaur three-toed trackway teaching model, without a genus or species assignment.
assets.form: A thin irregular mud patch with 2–3 shallow three-toed impressions in an alternating sequence; slight displaced rims; subtle wet/dry variation without breaking the whole patch into rubble.
assets.distinct: Directional negative impressions and a step sequence make this a behavioral-trace prop, not another ordinary rock slab.
assets.science: A true track begins as a foot impression in a substrate. Pressure can also deform underlying layers into undertracks. Three toes alone do not identify Dilophosaurus or another genus.
avoid: Raised sculpted toes
Perfectly aligned identical impressions
Claiming an in-situ Tyrannosaurus or Dilophosaurus track
Confusing fresh mud impressions with eroded fossil specimens
Monster-like five-clawed prints
assets.art: Depth, stride, and toe angles are schematic. Do not calculate speed or body mass from this artistic geometry.

zhCN.period: 中生代恐龙三趾行迹教学示意；不绑定具体属种
zhCN.form: 薄而不规则泥面；2–3个浅凹三趾印连续错步排列；印缘有轻微挤压隆起；局部干湿层次但不裂成碎石堆
zhCN.distinct: 带方向性的负形足迹和步序，是行为痕迹道具，不是另一块普通岩板
zhCN.science: 原始足迹为脚踩基底的凹印；底层足迹也可能因压力变形形成；三趾形本身不足以指定双冠龙等属
avoid: 脚趾做成凸浮雕
每枚印记完全同向正齐排
称霸王龙或双冠龙原位足迹
鲜泥印和被侵蚀化石标本混称
怪兽式五爪
zhCN.art: 印深、步长、趾角为示意；不从艺术几何推算速度/体重

assets.period: An arborescent lycopsid concept for a Late Carboniferous coal swamp, not a Mesozoic forest plant.
assets.form: A tall columnar trunk with a readable spiral pattern of diamond-shaped leaf cushions; 2–3 upper branching levels formed by dichotomies; narrow leaves concentrated on younger branches; a low spreading root base.
assets.distinct: The columnar trunk, leaf cushions, and upper dichotomous crown reflect lycopsid body structure rather than a recolored conifer.
assets.science: These trees were lycopsids. The scale-like pattern consists of leaf cushions, not reptilian scales. Crown form depends on age and growth stage.
avoid: Pine-like whorled lateral branches
Large pinnate palm leaves
Modern sawn-wood growth rings
A claimed same-place/same-time reconstruction with Tyrannosaurus
Treating this asset's dimensions as the maximum adult height of the group
assets.art: This design selects a branched-crown stage. Dimensions are an asset-display specification, not a complete life history or a measured fossil reconstruction.

zhCN.period: 晚石炭世煤沼中的鳞木类形态概念；本款不作为中生代森林植物
zhCN.form: 高柱状干，少量可读的螺旋菱形叶枕；顶部2–3级二歧分枝；狭长叶聚于较年轻分枝；低处浅展开的根座
zhCN.distinct: 柱状干/叶枕/顶部二歧分枝来自石松类身体结构；不是针叶树换叶色
zhCN.science: 鳞木类属于石松类；‘鳞’是叶枕痕迹而非爬行动物鳞片；年龄与生长阶段影响冠型
avoid: 松树轮生侧枝
棕榈羽状大叶
现代锯木年轮
与霸王龙同地同时复原
以本款尺寸代表所有成体最大高度
zhCN.art: 本款选取有分枝冠的阶段，尺寸为可展示资产规格；不是完整生命周期或具体标本复原
